title: Anagrelide remodels the PDE3A-SLFN12 interactome to associate with translation initiation machinery in cancer cell lines.
authors: Salmikangas, Sami; Lindholm, Iina; Sultana, Nasrin; Merikoski, Nanna; Toivanen, Kirsi; Liu, Xiaonan; Varjosalo, Markku; Bohling, Tom; Vesterinen, Tiina; Sihto, Harri
one_liner_zh: 该文通过邻近标记和AlphaFold建模研究药物诱导的PDE3A-SLFN12复合物与翻译起始机器的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白复合物结构建模，但核心是细胞信号网络而非蛋白质结构计算问题。
abstract: Phosphodiesterase 3A (PDE3A) modulators such as anagrelide induce complex formation between PDE3A and Schlafen 12 (SLFN12), selectively killing cancer cells that co-express both proteins. As PDE3A forms isoform- and cell type-specific signalosome complexes across multiple subcellular compartments, the effects of its modulation are expected to depend strongly on the surrounding protein interaction network. However, despite considerable pre-clinical and early clinical interest in PDE3A modulators, the cellular context in which these compounds act has remained poorly characterized. Using proximity-dependent biotinylation in two human cancer cell lines (SA-4, liposarcoma; HeLa, cervical adenocarcinoma), we mapped the interactomes of PDE3A, SLFN12, and the anagrelide-induced PDE3A-SLFN12 complex. Anagrelide induced 259 high-confidence interactions, most notably with ribosomal proteins and translation initiation factors, while suppressing 877 interactions, most prominently those associated with the proteasome, protein folding, and the ER membrane. Interactions were selectively induced with peripheral eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF3) subunits eIF3A and eIF3B, while interactions with core eIF3 subunits eIF3H, eIF3L, and eIF3M were suppressed. These findings were validated by native co-immunoprecipitation across three cancer cell lines, and multiplex immunofluorescence confirmed accumulation and ribosomal redistribution of both PDE3A and SLFN12 following anagrelide treatment. AlphaFold modeling of the PDE3A-SLFN12 complex with a partial 43S pre-initiation complex predicted binding near eIF3B and the eIF2alphabetagamma-tRNA ternary complex at the mRNA entry channel. By mapping the interactomes surrounding the drug-induced complex, our study provides important mechanistic context for how PDE3A modulators act within the cell. In our proposed model, anagrelide remodels the interactome of the PDE3A-SLFN12 complex, which relocalizes and accumulates near the mRNA entry channel of the 43S pre-initiation complex.
abstract_zh: 磷酸二酯酶3A（PDE3A）调节剂如阿那格雷（anagrelide）诱导PDE3A与Schlafen 12（SLFN12）之间形成复合物，选择性杀死共表达这两种蛋白的癌细胞。由于PDE3A在多个亚细胞区室中形成异构体特异性和细胞类型特异性的信号体复合物，其调节效应预计强烈依赖于周围的蛋白质相互作用网络。然而，尽管PDE3A调节剂在临床前和早期临床研究中引起了相当大的兴趣，这些化合物作用的细胞环境仍未被充分表征。利用两种人癌细胞系（SA-4，脂肪肉瘤；HeLa，宫颈腺癌）中的邻近依赖性生物素化标记，我们绘制了PDE3A、SLFN12以及阿那格雷诱导的PDE3A-SLFN12复合物的相互作用组图谱。阿那格雷诱导了259个高置信度相互作用，最显著的是与核糖体蛋白和翻译起始因子相关的相互作用，同时抑制了877个相互作用，其中最突出的是与蛋白酶体、蛋白质折叠和内质网膜相关的相互作用。相互作用被选择性诱导与外周真核翻译起始因子3（eIF3）亚基eIF3A和eIF3B，而核心eIF3亚基eIF3H、eIF3L和eIF3M的相互作用则被抑制。这些发现通过三种癌细胞系中的天然共免疫沉淀得到验证，多重免疫荧光确认了阿那格雷处理后PDE3A和SLFN12的积累及核糖体重新分布。对PDE3A-SLFN12复合物与部分43S前起始复合物的AlphaFold建模预测，其结合位点位于eIF3B和eIF2alphabetagamma-tRNA三元复合物附近的mRNA入口通道。通过绘制药物诱导复合物周围的相互作用组图谱，我们的研究为PDE3A调节剂如何在细胞内发挥作用提供了重要的机制背景。在我们提出的模型中，阿那格雷重塑了PDE3A-SLFN12复合物的相互作用组，该复合物重新定位并在43S前起始复合物的mRNA入口通道附近积累。
